Card Q&A.a: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [Aquatic] type trait.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly?

Effect: ＜Evade＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, by suspending this Digimon, it isn't deleted.)
Inherited Effect: ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
